free_tier.stated: Reported as 10 days retention and 5 NZBs per day on a free account, with no API because it is a forum. The site's own page lists an 'API Key Info' link, so the no-API claim was not confirmed.
free_tier.notes: The free allowance is third-party and undated; the paid tiers are GBP 14 per year (Supporter) and GBP 15.50 per year (Super Supporter) in the same listing.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: Reported as 10 days of retention on the free account.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

record.interface_detail: A vBulletin forum; the front page links Welcome Page, API Key Info and Donate / Upgrade.
record.tooling: The page lists an API Key Info link; whether a Newznab-style API exists was not read. Otherwise a wrapper has to drive the forum pages. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
record.chaining: A manual fallback; 10 days of retention on the free account makes it a recent-release grab only.

limits.value: reported: 10 days retention and 5 NZBs per day on a free account

record.binding_note: Ten days of retention is the shortest horizon named, and it is third-party.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the sign-up form was not readable; a third-party listing calls registration open and the site is a forum that takes a credit card only for the paid tiers.

record.reliability_note: The origin answers a bot wall (HTTP 403) with only the forum footer and menu text; the footer shows 2012 to 2025.
record.confidence_note: The allowance, the retention and the prices are third-party; only the menu entries come from the site, and a bot wall limited the read to them.

evidence.quote: 10 days retention, 5 NZBs/day (Forum, so there is no API)
evidence.proved: third-party: free account retention is 10 days with 5 NZBs per day
third-party: the Supporter tier is GBP 14 per year or GBP 17 for 3 years
the site page lists an API Key Info entry
the site is a vBulletin forum dated 2012 to 2025
